questions: Your Methods say "Three devices were measured" (p. 8), and p. 7 says "Measurements on the other devices show the same behavior". How many two-QPC devices were fabricated or cooled down in total, and how many reached a stable 5/2 plateau with QPCs usable for these measurements?
If any devices, cooldowns or QPC settings were set aside, why?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: QPC reflection settings, magnetic field positions on the 5/2 plateau, temperature, and source bias beyond about ±6 in e*V_S/2k_BT?

Figs. 1b and 2b come from data set 4 and Fig. 3b from data set 3 (p. 17), and for data set 1 you note that "the A-Pf prediction lies closer to the measured values" (p. 17). How were the main-text datasets chosen, and what do Figs. 2b and 3b look like for the second-best dataset in each configuration?

Could you run the same two-QPC sequence where no anyons are expected (for example partitioning an integer channel at ν = 2 or 3 in the same device), to show that both Fano factors come out at their trivial values with your normalization?

What neutral Fano factor would an edge with an Abelian upstream neutral mode (M_n different from 0) predict for your measured R_QPC1(V_S), and how far is it from the data in Fig. 3b? Both curves you show have M_n = 0.
How was the 10 mK electron temperature (p. 3) determined, and how far do the theoretical curves in Figs. 2b and 3b move for a 1 to 2 mK change?

Fig. S9 compares the heating model with data set 4 only. Does it fall short by a similar factor for data sets 1 to 3 and for the charged-anyon configuration, and how sensitive is it to the length hierarchy of Eq. (S56) and the heat split by central charge in Eq. (S61)?
